# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large mixed bag of call snippets, and the genuine **sales** content is a minority — most of the audio is internal ops chatter (Diwali gift distribution to dealers, driver/vehicle coordination, bill-copy/location sharing, loading, attendance). After filtering, roughly 35-45 calls are real sales/dealer-negotiation conversations: inbound enquiries for roofing sheets, screws, polycarbonate, PUFF panels, dealer rate negotiations, and a few quotation/measurement calls with fabricators and site engineers. Given this, the knowledge base below is grounded strictly in those real sales exchanges. Rates quoted in calls sometimes conflict (different dates/customers), so multiple values are shown as they occurred rather than reconciled into one "official" price.

## Products & brand ladder
Crayon Roofing & Structures (factory: Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai) sells/fabricates:

- **Metal roofing sheets (color-coated)** — core product. Brands/variants referenced:
  - **JSW Color On Plus** (0.47mm, 0.50mm) — premium line
  - **JSW Pragathi / Pragati Color On Plus** (0.47mm)
  - **JSW Radiance** — another JSW sub-brand, sometimes confused with Color On Plus by callers
  - **Asian Indradhanush / Asian Force** (0.45mm) — a cheaper alternative line, sourced via another dealer relationship ("Amar", "Everlast")
  - Thickness range in calls: 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.6mm
  - Colors: Sky Blue, Off White, Royal Blue, Grey/Dark Green ("Kali Sheet Green"), Half White
- **Tile-profile / trapezoidal profile sheets** — customer asked for "clay tile look"; rep clarified this is made at a *different* factory (puff/tile-profile unit), not the Manali metal-roofing unit.
- **PUFF insulated panels** (wall + roof, 50mm thickness) — for warehouse/fabrication sheds; a separate factory handles this; reps had to check specs internally before quoting.
- **Polycarbonate sheets (Lexan brand)** — thicknesses 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2mm, and "clear" 10mm; standard length capped at **15 feet**; used for skylights/canopies.
- **Roofing accessories**: L-flash, ridge, crimp, gutter, barge board, cutter (corner flashing) — priced by standard width (610mm); custom widths beyond that are billed as "full sheet," i.e., double rate.
- **MS Channel** (JSW brand, 125/65) — structural accessory, handled by a separate contact line.
- **Screws**:
  - Tata Agri self-drilling screws (various sizes: 25mm, M8, 55mm, 1", 2")
  - Rust-free screws
  - "Full thread" (FT) self-drilling/welding screws for fabrication
- **Welding rods** — dealer-network product with monthly volume-based schemes/gifts (not covered under roofing margin logic).
- **Explicitly NOT stocked** (lost-enquiry products): UPVC sheets, GI sheet (80/120 GSM spangle), liner sheets ("நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லை"), MS corrugated 1.2mm sheet.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.meter** (one call) vs **₹445 + GST / sq.meter** (another call, same product name) — price varies by date/negotiation.
- JSW Pragathi Color On Plus 0.47mm: **₹445 + GST / sq.meter**
- 10 ft sheet (JSW Color On Plus 0.47): **₹1,466 + 18% GST per sheet**
- Asian Indradhanush 0.45mm, 10 ft sheet: **₹1,251 + 18% GST + loading charge**
- Asian Force 0.45 Indradhanush: **₹370 + GST / sq.meter**
- Pragathi coil rate example: **₹410 + GST / sq.meter** (→ ₹484 incl. 18% GST)
- Running-meter vs square-meter weight conversion used by reps: **0.47mm sheet ≈ 4 kg per sq.meter** (~4.2 running-meter weight)
- Polycarbonate (clear) 2mm: **₹800 + GST / sq.meter**
- Polycarbonate 10mm clear: **₹61 + tax / sq.foot**
- PUFF 50mm panel: **₹1,650 + tax / sq.meter**, or quoted as **~₹2,000 per running meter** including GST
- Standard accessory width (L-flash/ridge/cutter) = **610mm**; within this width rate = **₹655**; beyond 610mm = full-sheet/double rate (e.g., ₹1,310 for 900mm width cutter)
- Screws: Tata 2" self-drilling **₹4.44 + tax**; rust-free 2" **₹4.66 + tax**; 1" **₹2.93 + tax** (full carton ~₹2,500); M8 55mm full-thread ~₹4.44/₹4.66 + tax
- Welding rod (dealer price): **₹356/packet incl. tax**, recently up from ₹336 (a "6% price increase" was repeatedly cited)
- **GST: 18%** on all items; no cash/without-GST billing — explicitly refused ("without GST பண்ண முடியாது")
- **Payment terms (quoted to a tile-profile/PUFF enquiry)**: **50% advance, balance 50% before delivery**; vehicle/transport is customer's scope
- Minimum screw order typically sold by **full carton/box** (200 pcs per small box, 2000 for master box)
- Rate increases are communicated informally before an official mail/circular (e.g., "20th தேதிக்கு மேல rate increase ஆகப்போகுது")

## Objection Playbook
- **"Cash bill-ல பண்ண முடியுமா, GST இல்லாம?"**
  → Firm refusal: *"இல்ல sir. without GST பண்ண முடியாது. with GST தான் full-ஆவே."* (No exceptions; GST is non-negotiable.)

- **"Rate கொஞ்சம் குறைக்க முடியுமா?" / price-shopping dealer**
  → Reps offer small negotiable room only via escalation: *"₹5 குறைச்சு கேட்டு பார்க்கலாம்"* — but final discount always needs owner/manager sign-off, not decided by the telecaller.

- **Customer confuses size units (kg vs sq.meter vs sq.feet)**
  → Reps patiently reconvert: *"square feet-னா நம்ம square meter-ல தான் rate இருக்கு தர முடியும்."* Multiple calls show confusion resolved by walking through conversion step by step.

- **Long-distance/out-of-area enquiry (e.g., Tirunelveli, Coimbatore, Hyderabad)**
  → Politely decline delivery feasibility: *"ரொம்ப long distance-ஆ இருக்கும். Plus transportation scope உங்களது. ரொம்ப அதிகமா charges எடுத்துக்கும். So உங்க local-லயே நீங்க check பண்ணி பார்க்கலாம்."*

- **Wrong product expectation (UPVC/GI/liner sheet not stocked)**
  → Honest redirection: *"நம்ம metal roofing sheet தான் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்."* — no false promising, enquiry closed cleanly.

- **Quality complaint from dealer (face/surface issue)**
  → Resolution offered as replacement OR a debit-note style discount adjusted against the next order's bill amount — a concrete, used recovery tactic.

- **Wastage/cutting objection (fabricator doesn't want oversize flashing)**
  → Rep explains technical reasoning (bend/die tolerance) calmly, then offers to escalate to production/line man
